chapter.verse: Tu-in thunget hun ahi sunnung nai thum ciangin biakinnpi ah Peter leh John paito uh hi.
Tua laitak a suah tuung-a kipan a khebai mi khat hong kipua hi. Amah pen biakinnpi sunga lut mite' kiangah khutdawh ngen dingin Hoih Kongpi a kici biakinnpi kongpi ah nisimin a kikoih ahi hi.
Tua mipa in biakinnpi sung lut dinga kithawi Peter leh John a muh ciangin khutdawh ngen hi.
Peter in, John mah bangin, tua mipa tangtak enin, “Hong en in,” ci hi.
Tua mipa zong bang hiamkhat ngah ding lametna tawh amau' lam hong nga hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in, “Kham leh ngun ka nei kei hi. Himah taleh ka neih kong pia ding hi. Nazareth khuami Jesu Khris' min tawh dingto inla lampai in!” ci hi.
Tua ciangin a khut taklam tawh tua mipa lenin phongto a, tua mipa a khepekte leh a khe-ngawngte thakhat thu-in khauh hi.
Tua ciangin amah dingto diangto-in lampai kisin a, lampai kawm, laam kawm, Pasian phat kawmin amau tawh biakinnpi sung lut hi.
Tua bangin lampai-in Pasian phatin a om pen mi khempeuh in mu uh a,
biakinnpi Hoih Kongpi ah a tu khutdawhngenpa ahihlam khenthei uh hi. Ama' tunga thupiang hangin amaute zong lamdangsakna leh lungmanna tawh kidim uh hi.
Tua mipa, Peter leh John luaicipin a om laitak, mi khempeuh lamdang sa lua-in amau' omna Solomon' min kivawh talap ah hong tai ngeingai uh hi.

Peter in tua a muh ciangin mite tungah hih bangin gentelna nei hi: “Israel mite aw, hih thu bang hangin lamdang sa na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin hih mipa komau' vangliatna tawh, ahihkeileh komau' biakna lungsim tawh lam a paitheisak bang khatin hong sal gega na hi uh hiam?

Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, leh Jacob' Pasian, i pupite' Pasian in Ama' nasem Jesu minpha pia hi. Tua Jesu na lehhek uh a, Pilate in khahkhiat ding a khensat khit pen Pilate' mai mah ah amah na nolh uh hi.
Siangthopa leh Midikpa nolhin tualthat khat hong kikhahsak ding hehpih na ngen uh a,
nuntakna Phungpipa na that uh hi. Pasian in misite' lakpan amah thokiksak a, tua thu ah kote teci ka hi uh hi.
Jesu' min upna hangin tua min in hih na muh na theih uh mipa thahatsak khinzo a, Jesu' tungpana kingah tua upna in note khempeuh' mai-ah hih mipa damsiangna pia khinzo hi.
“Tu-in sanggamte aw, note pen na uliante mah bangun theih loh manin a gamta na hi uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in kamsangte khempeuh' tungtawna a genkholh, ama' Khris in sihna thuak ding cih thu, tu-a bangin a tangtungsak ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin kisik unla na mawhnate uh a kinulsiang theih nadingin kiheikik un.
Tua hileh Topa' ompihna pana hong pai thathak kidipna hunte hong tung ding a, note' adinga kiseh Khris ahi tua Jesu hong sawl ding hi.
Sawtpi lai pekin Pasian in a kamsang siangthote' tungtawnin a gen, na khempeuh a bawlhoihkik ding hun a tun matengin vantung in amah a kep a kul ahi hi.
Moses in, ‘Topa Pasian in note' adingin keimah bang kamsang khat na sanggamte uh sungpan hong khangsak ding hi. Note in ama' hong cih bangbang na mang ding uh hi.
Tua kamsangpa' thu a manglo mihing kici khempeuh teeltuam minam lakpan kilongkhiasiang ding hi,’ ci hi.
Samuel-a kipan ama' nunga hong piang kamsang thugente khempeuh in zong tu-a hunlenite mah a pulak uh ahi hi.

Note pen kamsangte' suanlekhakte na hi uh a, Pasian in, ‘Na suanlekhakte tungtawnin leitung innkuante khempeuh in thupha ngah ding uh hi,’ ci-in Abraham hopihin na pu na pate uh tawh a bawl thuciamna ii tate na hi uh hi.
Pasian in note na vekun na gitlohna uh pan kiheikikna tawh thupha hong piak nadingin ama' nasempa laamto-in note' kiangah hong sawl masa ahi hi.”
